ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Tender and estimate, Preferred bidder and later stages need Amount, Retention and Expected start date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Tender_estimate", CASE(StageName, "Opportunity", 1, "Go or no-go", 2, "Estimating", 3, "Bid submitted", 4, "Clarification", 5, "Preferred bidder", 6, "Awarded", 7, 0) >= 6, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Retention_percent__c), ISBLANK(Expected_start_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Retention and Expected start date before moving to Preferred bidder.
